correctness.rationale: The weighted Cayley extension law, conditional squared-degree expansion and polynomial telescoping prove the exact all-size covariance. The maximal-distance endpoint and small-size degeneracies are handled separately. A nonzero four-term lower bound proves strict sign; exact rational independent Prüfer enumeration of 280392 trees through size eight corroborates 84 identities. Wiener asymptotic explicitly depends on Janson (2003), not on finite enumeration.

originality.rationale: The exact cross-moment, distance-resolved squared-degree regression and all-size strict-sign claim are not statements of the inspected strongest primary full texts; targeted literature-index comparison searches also found no covering form. The prior conditional first-power single-vertex degree calculation lacks the off-path squared-degree information necessary to recover the Zagreb covariance. Distinct random recursive tree laws and marginal-Wiener/marginal-Zagreb results do not imply this mixed covariance. Potential older bivariate index enumerators remain a genuine residual risk.
residual_risks: An old bivariate or weighted graph-index enumerator for Cayley trees might encode this exact covariance under another name.
Full text of Feng–Hu 2011 and Wagner 2014 was not available in the completed access attempts, though their documented models/advertised conclusions do not directly imply this theorem.
Searches of academic indexes and semantic finding databases cannot establish universal novelty or access other unpublished discoveries.

value.rationale: First Zagreb measures quadratic local degree concentration, Wiener measures global all-pairs distance. Their exact finite mixed moment is not determined by marginals and gives a uniform negative sign, a sharp size threshold, a distance-conditioned structural mechanism and a nontrivial order n^(5/2) dependence scale, all natural for random trees.
